name: Build Thought Leadership
description: Strategic workflow for professionals who want to establish thought leadership in their field. Covers finding a niche where your perspective is unique, creating a consistent content engine, building visibility across platforms, establishing authority through speaking, writing, and community, and monetizing your thought leadership through consulting, courses, and advisory roles. Use when the user wants to build thought leadership or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
